qa_pair.question: Which query had the highest CTR (among queries with at least 100 impressions) on {SITE} during the 28 days starting {SNAPSHOT_START}? Report the exact query string.
Across all top pages of {SITE} during the window {SNAPSHOT_START} to {SNAPSHOT_END}, how many distinct pages rank between position 4 and position 10 inclusive? Return the count as an integer.

Compare the 28-day window starting {SNAPSHOT_START} against the immediately preceding 28-day window for {SITE}. What is the percentage change in total clicks, rounded to the nearest whole number and prefixed with + or -?
Inspect the URL {SITE}/ (the site root) on {SITE}. What is the coverageState returned by the index status? Return it exactly as the API reports it.
For {SITE}, how many sitemaps are currently submitted that have at least one warning? Return the count.

Using the cannibalization check on {SITE} for the window {SNAPSHOT_START} to {SNAPSHOT_END}, which query has the most pages competing for it? Return the exact query string. (If multiple tie, return the alphabetically first.)
For {SITE} over the window {SNAPSHOT_START} to {SNAPSHOT_END}, how many queries have an average position between 4.0 and 10.0 AND more than 500 impressions? Return the integer count.
Run the opportunity analyzer on {SITE} with analysisType "standard". How many opportunities are classified as high priority? Return the integer count.
On {SITE} during the window {SNAPSHOT_START} to {SNAPSHOT_END}, which single page received the most clicks? Return its absolute URL.
Submit a bulk inspection of the three URLs {SITE}/, {SITE}/about, and {SITE}/contact on {SITE}. How many of the three return verdict "PASS" on indexStatusResult? Return the integer count.
